candidates.tagline: 148 teams, one jury, one winner. Ecuador: 'It looks like DoodleBob.'
candidates.story: Studio Campo Baeza and MAODA won an international competition to design Ecuador's new National Museum with 'Echoes of the Sun' — announced July 6, 2026 — but within days 20,000 Ecuadorians signed a petition comparing the concrete block to a cardboard box and DoodleBob from SpongeBob, the Vice Minister of Culture resigned, and the government 'recalled' the winning design.
candidates.why_funny: 148 architecture teams from 20+ countries competed, an international expert jury crowned a winner, and Ecuador's public response was to circulate a petition calling the proposed national museum a SpongeBob character — and the government agreed.
candidates.alt: Architectural rendering of the MUNA Quito competition-winning design — a massive pale concrete cube with irregularly-spaced rectangular window cutouts on its facade, set in a city block next to La Carolina Park with Quito's mountains visible in the background
candidates.credit: Studio Campo Baeza / MAODA via ArchDaily

candidates.tagline: Amazon's self-driving cab got confused by smoke — a human had to reverse it.
candidates.story: Amazon's Zoox robotaxi drove into an active fire scene in Las Vegas on June 20, 2026, braked hard when it hit heavy smoke, and was unable to back itself out — a human teleoperator had to remotely reverse it so first responders could place cones; Zoox then issued a software recall for all 105 of its self-driving vehicles because none had been programmed to detect smoke.
candidates.why_funny: The vehicle designed to eliminate human driving error needed a human to perform the most basic manoeuvre — reversing — because nobody thought to teach it that fires produce smoke.
candidates.alt: A black Zoox autonomous robotaxi van seen from behind on a city street, with sensor pods on its roof and two square orange rear lights that resemble cartoon eyes
